name: MoD
caption: A stable led by Grim Reaper that lost a Scaffold Match to Creep and Pain on December 17, 1998.
notes: The fed's own served Roster page bills Grim Reaper as "leader of MoD"; Necromancer's own roster entry names Grim Reaper as his tag team partner without using the group's own name "MoD," so his own membership here is a presumed extension from that pairing rather than a primary-source-explicit one. No further member is named anywhere in the held corpus.
